name: Lia
backstory: Lia, Cal, and Rolan grew up together. While Lia and Cal are biological siblings, all three of them maintain a sibling relationship with each other. Out of the trio, Lia's views on honor and duty differ sharply from those of Rolan, often leading to forceful disagreements with him.
